I am an old man now, 68 years, and this small plot of beans is close to my house. I intercrop them as I always have, and the beans help the soil so I do not need to buy the expensive chemical fertilizer for them — I save that for my maize plot if the coupon comes. I will use the seed I saved from last season, and my wife and grandchildren will help me weed. Pesticide is too costly for beans, and here in Thyolo we depend on the rains, I have no way to irrigate.
